Why train with us

  • One training base

    All our training runs from a single local base, so you know where you're going and who you're dealing with.

  • Plain-English advice

    We explain which licence you need, what the training involves and what happens next before you commit to anything.

  • Time in the vehicle

    Training centres on the manoeuvres and road driving the test involves, with practice in the vehicle rather than slides.

  • Local road knowledge

    Road work uses the roads around our base, so you practise where you're most likely to be driving.

How HGV training works

From first enquiry to training day, in four steps.

  1. Tell us what you want to drive

    Category C, Category C+E or Driver CPC. If you're not sure, say so and we'll talk it through.

  2. We check what you already hold

    We look at your current licence and explain any medical, theory or CPC steps that go alongside the practical training.

  3. Train from our local base

    Practical sessions run from our single training base. We agree dates with you once you've enquired.

  4. Prepare for what comes next

    That might be your practical test or periodic CPC hours. We explain how booking works when you get in touch.

Common questions

Which licence do I need?

Category C is the usual route onto a rigid lorry. Category C+E adds a trailer. Driver CPC is the professional qualification, not a vehicle category. The HGV training page compares them, and you can ask us if you're not sure.

How much does training cost?

We quote for each learner, because the right training depends on the licence you hold and how much practice you need. Send an enquiry and tell us what you want to drive.

Where does the training take place?

From our single local base. We send the full address and directions once your training is arranged.

Are the reviews on this site real?

No. This is a demonstration website, so the reviews are fictional samples and no rating is shown.

Ask about training

Tell us which licence you are aiming for, or that you are not sure yet, and we will point you in the right direction.
